note: Talks at the counter after a served drink: by ghost id, then the serving character's id or any. Each talk is told once (the career remembers it); who is ghost or me.

any.text: We were the lamp's. Then the lamp went out in '44.
And you stayed for the dark?
We stayed for the next light. Yours will do.

huy.text: Your little lamp on your forehead. May we?
Not while I'm filming, okay? Chat would lose it.

any.text: Black, no sugar. Like the cellar.
What is down there?
The old stage. And the boy under it.

mai.text: Caretaker. You still leave rice by the trap door.
Someone has to feed him, dear.
We eat it. He never comes up.

any.text: Rope burns. Milk helps, I find.
Who strung you up there?
The patron's man. I saw the fire start before the bombs did.

bao.text: Doctor. You wrote 'fall from the flies' on my paper.
Did I, Mr. Stagehand? Was it not a fall?
It was a long one. It ended in a knot.

any.text: Line?
I don't have a line.
Everyone has a line. Yours comes in the last act.

lan.text: The masks you came to price. I knew the faces under them.
Then you know they are worth more with stories, sir.

any.text: Ticket, please.
I work here now. Behind the counter.
Then you have the worst seat in the house. Welcome.

khang.text: You hit me twice on the stairs, boss.
You were in my way, old man. Coffee's on me, okay?
Coffee is on the house. Everything is.

any.text: Iced, please. It was so hot that night.
The night of the raid?
The night of the singer. The raid only helped.

huy.text: I didn't film anything last year. I wasn't... was I here?

any.text: We sang behind her. Nobody remembers the chorus.
I'll remember. What did you sing?
The song she never finished. Hum it with us.

mai.text: Little Mai. You swept under our feet.
I was eight. You were kind to me.

any.text: Sweet. Cold. Many cups.
One cup each, please.
Then I have eight cups.

bao.text: Your hands do not shake, doctor.
Thirty years of practice. Do yours?

any.text: Something with ice. My fingers are still warm from the keys.
Do you still play?
Every night at midnight. The house listens.

lan.text: You priced my piano once. Too low.
The keys were burnt, sir. I priced what was left.

any.text: I sold the last ticket that night. To him.
To the patron?
He paid in gold. I can still feel it burning.

khang.text: A debt, kid. Same as always.
The house collects too. It is ahead of you in line.
